field.name: partyId
field.description: The Party the content is for

field.name: partyId
field.description: The Party the email was sent to, for different emails sent to different parties associated with an order

field.name: processingStatusId
field.description: Sub-status for use when statusId=OrderProcessing for custom pre-approve status flows

field.name: terminalId
field.description: ID for the terminal, such as a POS system, where the order was recorded

field.name: displayId
field.description: ID to display to customers, can be different from orderId and/or externalId

field.name: externalId
field.description: ID for the order in the direct upstream system it came from if it came from an external system

field.name: originId
field.description: ID for the order in the original system it came from (system of record) if not the direct upstream system

field.name: originUrl
field.description: URL to view the order on the original system it came from

field.name: parentOrderId
field.description: The original/parent order this is based on, used for all order clones including recurring orders

field.name: recurCronExpression
field.description: If populated is a recurring order, automatically cloned if in Approved status

field.name: lastOrderedDate
field.description: For recurring orders the date/time of the most recent clone/recurrence

field.name: recurAutoInvoice
field.description: If Y and cloned recurring order successfully auto-approved then also invoice/bill the order immediately

field.name: statusId
field.description: OrderHeader status the decision is meant for

field.name: productParameterSetId
field.description: For a set of Product Parameters to personalize a Product and/or record details specific to a purchase of the Product. If used represents a distinct Product instance (OrderItem, etc records should not be combined unless matches).

field.name: priority
field.description: NOTE: this may be deprecated in favor of OrderPart.priority

field.name: unitAmount
field.description: The purchase or sales price. For barter/exchange orders this represents the market value of the item at the time of the exchange in terms of the OrderHeader.currencyUomId.

field.name: productStandardCostId
field.description: The approved sales estimate applied when the line was created; purchase accounting keeps standardCost unchanged.

field.name: standardCost
field.description: For purchase orders the cost for accounting purposes if different from unitAmount. Used to set Asset.acquireCost on receipt.

field.name: fromAssetId
field.description: Order for a particular Asset, not just any associated with the Product.

field.name: promoQuantity
field.description: For promo items. The quantity of the parent order item 'consumed' by the promotion, excluding from use in other promotions if promotion set to limit by this.

field.name: promoTimesUsed
field.description: For promo items. The number of times the promo was used for use limits.

field.name: promoCodeText
field.description: Promo code(s) entered by customer used for the item, may be from external system

field.name: finAccountId
field.description: Populate along with finAccountTransId for gift card/certificate/etc purchase and replenishment

field.name: overrideGlAccountId
field.description: Used to specify the override or actual glAccountId used for the item.

field.name: sourcePercentage
field.description: The percentage used for tax, promo, etc items

field.name: amountAlreadyIncluded
field.description: The amount here is already represented in the item price, such as VAT taxes.

field.name: exemptAmount
field.description: An amount that would normally apply, but not to this order; for tax exemption represents the what the tax would have been.

field.name: customerReferenceId
field.description: For tax entries this is partyTaxId

field.name: shipmentId
field.description: For physical items the assetIssuanceId can be used to find the Shipment but for adjustments and such, possibly prorated for a particular Shipment, this is the way to find it.

field.name: partyId
field.description: The Party who the FormResponse information is for or about

field.name: vendorPartyId
field.description: The vendor (seller) of the items in the order part.

field.name: customerPartyId
field.description: The customer (buyer) of the items in the order part.

field.name: facilityId
field.description: The Facility to fulfill the order from (if null look up from ProductStore), or for purchase orders the Facility the order will be shipped to.

field.name: settlementTermId
field.description: Settlement (payment) term for auto order payments and set on Invoice(s) based on this OrderPart

field.name: priority
field.description: Numeric priority, 1 to 9 where 1 is highest priority and 9 is lowest priority (like a to do list), defaults to 5

field.name: requiredWork
field.description: If Y require WorkEffort Status of Complete, Closed, or Cancelled to consider OrderItem fulfilled

field.name: forStatusId
field.description: Task must be Complete or Closed before change to this status (soft rule, depending on code in place)

field.name: invoicePercent
field.description: For a milestone (WetMilestone): the share of the order item's total its completion releases to be invoiced (mantle.account.InvoiceServices.create#MilestoneInvoiceItems)

field.name: invoiceAmount
field.description: For a milestone: a fixed amount released in place of invoicePercent

entity.description: Why an order (or one of its parts) is on hold: a credit, change, purchase or manual reason, the record that caused it (sourceId: a credit check, a change request, a revision), who placed it and when, and who released it, when and why. The order is on OrderHold while any reason is open; release#OrderHold releases one reason and moves the order back (to returnStatusId, Approved by default) only when no other reason is open.

field.name: returnStatusId
field.description: The status the order returns to when its last reason is released.

entity.description: A public cart's access: the open order, the scope (site, Shop mount, store and currency), the verified customer (a signed-in account's party, empty for a guest, whose order part carries an anonymous guest party once its checkout begins), the session capability's digest (rotated at sign-in and sign-out), a one-time recovery token's digest (Commerce P10), the last shopper activity and the expiry it extends, and retirement (revokedDate with its reason, and the cart a merge moved it into). merge#Parties moves customerPartyId and guestPartyId with the party; nothing moves a cart on an email address.

field.name: customerPartyId
field.description: The verified customer: the signed-in account's party that made or attached the cart; empty for a guest's.

field.name: guestPartyId
field.description: The anonymous customer party begin#Checkout made for a guest's cart (none before its checkout begins, SEC-PSS-05), kept on the order part so the sales commercial revision applies.

field.name: capabilityDigest
field.description: The digest of the presentation session's capability; the capability itself is never stored.

field.name: recoveryTokenDigest
field.description: A one-time recovery link's token digest (Commerce P10); empty once spent.

field.name: lastActivityDate
field.description: The last shopper action (an add, change, removal, code or sign-in); reads and repricing do not touch it.

entity.description: One checkout of a cart: its state (StoreCheckout status), the store policy it began under, the buyer's contact, the order part's delivery and billing addresses, the delivery quote it chose (carrier, method, amount, the order revision it was quoted at and its expiry), the payment option, the terms page version shown, and once submitted the snapshot of what is charged (its hash and the frozen orderRevision), the payment of its current attempt, the return reference's key digest (the narrow capability a provider's return and a refreshed frontend use), the placement's intent and outcome, and the guest's order capability. One unresolved submission per frozen revision.

field.name: customerPartyId
field.description: The order part's customer: the signed-in account's party, else the cart's guest party.

field.name: accountCheckout
field.description: Y when a signed-in account began it.

field.name: policyJson
field.description: The store's checkout policy (StoreCheckout.js checkoutPolicy) when the checkout began.

field.name: addressSuggestionId
field.description: A carrier's corrected address offered for the delivery address (validate#PostalAddress), never applied unless the shopper takes it.

field.name: savePaymentMethod
field.description: A signed-in buyer asked to keep the card (a profile is saved after an approved hosted payment).

field.name: snapshotJson
field.description: What is charged, frozen under the order's lock before any provider call: lines, adjustments, delivery, tax and total.

field.name: paymentId
field.description: The payment of the current attempt.

field.name: returnReference
field.description: The reference a provider's return and the result page carry (with its key).

field.name: placementIntentDate
field.description: Recorded, and committed, before place#Order is called; recovery reads the order's status.

field.name: reviewJson
field.description: What changed at the last freeze (a price, a quote, the tax, an item no longer offered, a promotion past its limit, the terms), which the shopper reviews before submitting again.

field.name: orderCapabilityId
field.description: The guest's SalesOrder OrderView capability (ExternalAccess), issued once at the first confirmation.

entity.description: A supplier's response from the PASS Supplier app to one revision of a quote order or purchase order: a quote response's private draft (state draft) and the receipt of what was submitted (state submitted), an acknowledgement's or a drop-ship delivery report's receipt. A repeat of the operation, or a second submission of the same revision, answers its receipt.

field.name: responseKind
field.description: QuoteResponse, OrderAcknowledgement or DeliveryReport

field.name: recordRevision
field.description: The quote's RFQ revision (its time in milliseconds), or the purchase order's orderRevision, the response answers

field.name: state
field.description: draft or submitted

field.name: contactPartyId
field.description: The signed-in contact's party, for a response with no token

field.name: dataJson
field.description: What the supplier entered (a draft, or what was submitted)

field.name: resultJson
field.description: The receipt the page shows
